pairs: Factum est autem in illo tempore, ut Amraphel rex Sennaar,
Now it happened in that time that Amraphel, king of Shinar,
and Chedorlaomer, king of the Elamites,
and Tidal, king of the Nations,
inirent bellum contra Bara regem Sodomorum,
went to war against Bera, king of Sodom,
and against Birsha, king of Gomorrah,
and against Shinab, king of Admah,
and against Shemeber, king of Zeboiim,
contraque regem Balæ, ipsa est Segor.
and against the king of Bela, that is Zoar.
Omnes hi convenerunt in vallem Silvestrem,
All these came together in the wooded valley,
which is now the Sea of Salt.
For they had served Chedorlaomer for twelve years,
et tertiodecimo anno recesserunt ab eo.
and in the thirteenth year they withdrew from him.
Therefore, in the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer arrived,
et reges qui erant cum eo:
and the kings who were with him.
And they struck the Rephaim at Ashteroth of the two horns,
and the Chorreans in the mountains of Seir,
even to the plains of Paran,
Reversique sunt, et venerunt ad fontem Misphat,
And they returned and arrived at the fountain of Mishpat,
And they struck the entire region of the Amalekites,
et Amorrhæum, qui habitabat in Asasonthamar.
and the Amorites who dwelt in Hazazontamar.
and indeed the king of Bela,
et direxerunt aciem contra eos in valle Silvestri:
And they directed their point against them in the wooded valley,
namely, against Chedorlaomer, king of the Elamites,
and Tidal, king of the Nations,
Vallis autem Silvestris habebat puteos multos bituminis. Itaque rex Sodomorum,
Now the wooded valley had many pits of bitumen.
et Gomorrhæ, terga verterunt, cecideruntque ibi:
And so the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah turned back and they fell there.
Tulerunt autem omnem substantiam Sodomorum et Gomorrhæ,
Then they took all the substance of the Sodomites and the Gomorrhites,
et universa quæ ad cibum pertinent,
and all that pertained to food,
one who had escaped reported it to Abram the Hebrew,
qui habitabat in convalle Mambre Amorrhæi, fratris Escol,
who lived in the steep valley of Mamre the Amorite, who was the brother of Eshcol,
hi enim pepigerant fœdus cum Abram.
For these had formed an agreement with Abram.
numeravit expeditos vernaculos suos trecentos decem et octo:
that his brother Lot had been taken captive,
he numbered three hundred and eighteen of his own armed men and he went in pursuit all the way to Dan.
he rushed upon them in the night.
et persecutus est eos usque Hoba,
and pursued them as far as Hobah,
which is on the left hand of Damascus.
And he brought back all the substance,
et Lot fratrem suum cum substantia illius,
likewise the women and the people.
Egressus est autem rex Sodomorum in occursum ejus postquam reversus est a cæde Chodorlahomor,
Then the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after he returned from the slaughter at Chedorlaomer,
et regum qui cum eo erant in valle Save,
and the kings who were with him at the valley of Shaveh,
which is the valley of the king.
Then in truth, Melchizedek, the king of Salem,
for he was a priest of the Most High God;
“Blessed be Abram by the Most High God,
And blessed be the Most High God,
quo protegente, hostes in manibus tuis sunt.
through whose protection the enemies are in your hands.”
Et dedit ei decimas ex omnibus.
And he gave him tithes from everything.
Dixit autem rex Sodomorum ad Abram:
Then the king of Sodom said to Abram,
and take the rest for yourself.”
Levo manum meam ad Dominum Deum excelsum possessorem cæli et terræ,
“I lift up my hand to the Lord God, the Most High, the Possessor of heaven and earth,
quod a filo subtegminis usque ad corigiam caligæ,
that from one thread within a blanket, even to a single shoelace,
non accipiam ex omnibus quæ tua sunt,
I will not take anything from that which is yours,
except that which the young men have eaten,
et partibus virorum, qui venerunt mecum,
and the shares for the men who came with me:
